name: bg.imotai/imotai
title: ImotAI — Bulgarian real estate
description: Bulgarian real-estate listings, district prices, market reports and purchase costs from imotai.bg.

tools.name: list_districts
tools.description: List the districts (neighbourhoods) of a Bulgarian city that ImotAI has data for, with the count of active listings in each where a public price page exists. Call this first to learn which "district" values are valid for the other ImotAI tools in a given city.

city.description: City slug ("sofia") or its Bulgarian name ("София").

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search Bulgarian real-estate listings on imotai.bg by city, district, property type, price range, area range and rooms. Returns up to 25 listings with structured fields, a link to each, and a district-level marketContext block (district average price per m² and how far this listing deviates from it). No contact details or free-text descriptions.

rooms.description: CSV of room counts, e.g. "2,3"; "5+" for 5 or more.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Get the full structured data for one ImotAI listing by its id or slug: price, price per m², area, rooms, floor, construction, heating, location (city/district), features, and an authoritative per-listing marketContext (district average and median price per m², deviation percent, comparable active count). Does NOT return the broker free-text description, contact details, or exact coordinates.

id.description: The listing id (UUID) or its URL slug.

tools.name: get_market_stats
tools.description: Asking-price statistics for apartments for sale in a Bulgarian city or district on imotai.bg — the same figures as imotai.bg/ceni and imotai.bg/facts. Use medianPricePerSqm, pricePerSqm (P25/P50/P75), sampleSize, asOf and priceSource for the price. catalogue.* (count, average total price, price quartiles, by-room breakdown) and neighbouringDistricts are averages over the smaller ImotAI catalogue — label them as such. Legacy top-level count/avgPrice/avgPricePerSqm/price/byRooms are kept for compatibility (see deprecatedFields; avgPricePerSqm is the median when priceSource is market_sweep). Returns { available: false } below 8 offers.

district.description: District slug or name from list_districts; omit for city-level stats.

tools.name: estimate_value
tools.description: Rough price positioning for a property by city, district, type and area — based on the CURRENT ASKING PRICES of comparable active listings, not on closed transactions. Returns an estimate, a low–high range, a confidence level from sample size, and a mandatory disclaimer. Refuses below 5 comparable offers. You MUST show the "disclaimer" field to the user verbatim whenever you cite any number from this tool. Never call this an official or precise property valuation.

district.description: District slug or name from list_districts.

rooms.description: Accepted but not used for filtering.

tools.name: get_market_report
tools.description: The monthly ImotAI market report for a Bulgarian city: median asking price per m² of apartments for sale, change versus the previous month, the same per district, and the number of new listings in the month. Omit "month" for the latest report. Cite the "url" and "source" fields when you use the numbers.

month.description: Report month as YYYY-MM, e.g. "2026-10". Omit for the latest.

tools.name: calculate_transaction_costs
tools.description: Buyer-side costs of buying a property in Bulgaria — local transfer tax of the municipality, notary fee, VAT on the notary fee, registration fee, optional broker commission and additional (e.g. mortgage) costs — plus the total own funds needed: purchasePrice − loanAmount + total costs. Same calculation as the cost calculator on imotai.bg listings. Pass propertyId to use a listing's price and location, or purchasePrice with city/municipality. Values you pass are used for this calculation only; the listing is never changed. If the municipal rate is unknown, complete is false and ownFundsRequired is null — never guess a total. Excludes interest, monthly payments and seller costs. Show the "disclaimer" and any "warnings" to the user.

propertyId.description: ImotAI listing id (UUID) or URL slug.

purchasePrice.description: Purchase price in EUR; overrides the listing price for this calculation.

city.description: Settlement in Bulgarian, e.g. "Стара Загора", "Слънчев бряг".

region.description: Province (област) — disambiguates settlements with the same name.

taxAssessment.description: Tax assessment (данъчна оценка) in EUR; if higher than the price, tax and fees use it.

loanAmount.description: Actual mortgage amount in EUR (0 or omitted = no loan). Not assumed to be 85%.

brokerCommissionPercent.description: Broker commission paid by the buyer, % of price.

brokerCommissionVatIncluded.description: true = add 20% VAT on top of the commission.

additionalCosts.description: Other buyer costs in EUR (bank valuation, bank fees, mortgage notary).
